question: What is the spiritual condition of one who acts as guru without knowing this tantra?
premises: Such a person may act as guru among all
Even as a disciple he remains bound
His condition is compared to an animal always
inference: One who teaches without knowing this tantra remains perpetually in a bound, animal-like state.
plain_english: O goddess, even if he is a guru to all, he is always like an animal, even as a disciple.
